name: Grok Build
tagline: xAI's terminal-based AI coding agent for full-size codebases
description: Grok Build is a terminal-native AI coding agent from the Grok ecosystem, built in Rust and released under Apache-2.0. It ships a fullscreen, mouse-interactive TUI that lets the agent edit files, run shell commands, search the web, and carry out long-running tasks in one session. A headless mode supports CI and scripting, while an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) interface enables embedding inside editors. It lands as a direct competitor to Claude Code and Codex from within the Grok family.
highlights: Fullscreen mouse-interactive TUI for driving agentic coding sessions
Native file editing, shell execution, web search, and long-running task support
Headless mode for CI pipelines and automation scripts
ACP (Agent Client Protocol) support for embedding in editors
curatorNote: Worth watching as the Grok ecosystem's answer to Claude Code and Codex — explosive adoption (~24k stars in four weeks) signals a serious terminal-agent contender.
